paragraphs.en: Given the {astonishing} potential of {AI} to transform our lives, from {transport} to healthcare ( (医疗保健) ), we all need to take action to deal with our AI-powered future, and this is where AI by Design: A Plan for Living with Artificial Intelligence comes in.This {absorbing} book by the {British} tech {celebrity} Catriona Campbell presents a {civil} discussion on artificial intelligence and its impact on society.The book is not just a {directory} of AI-related concepts, but a map that {charts} the journey of AI development, from its roots in computer science to its {frontier} applications.
paragraphs.cn: 鉴于 <u> 人工智能 </u> 具有改变我们生活的 <u> 惊人 </u> 潜力，从 <u> 交通运输 </u> 到医疗保健领域，我们都需要采取行动来应对人工智能主导的未来，而《设计人工智能：与 <u> 人工 </u> 智能的共存计划》这本书应运而生。这本 <u> 引人入胜的 </u> 书由 <u> 英国 </u> 科技界 <u> 名人 </u> 卡特里奥娜·坎贝尔所著，对人工智能及其对社会的影响展开了 <u> 理性 </u> 探讨。该书不仅是一本人工智能相关概念的 <u> 名录 </u> ，而且是一幅 <u> 描绘 </u> 人工智能发展历程的地图，涵盖人工智能从计算机科学领域的起源，到 <u> 前沿 </u> 应用的整个过程。

paragraphs.en: In the wrong hands, such a book could prove as complicated to process as the computer code that {powers} AI but, {thankfully} , Campbell {reviews} her two decades of professional experience and translates the {complex} into the {understandable} .She {carves} out a clear path for readers to follow, writing from the practical {angle} of a business person rather than as an academic, providing a comprehensive {summary} in a {polite} yet {frank} tone, which is highly accessible and informative.
paragraphs.cn: 倘若落入不懂行之人的手中，这本书可能会像 <u> 驱动 </u> 人工智能的计算机代码一样晦涩难懂。但 <u> 幸运的是 </u> ，坎贝尔 <u> 回顾 </u> 了自己20年的专业经验，将 <u> 复杂的 </u> 内容表述得 <u> 通俗易懂 </u> 。她以商业人士而非学者的务实 <u> 视角 </u> 进行写作，为读者 <u> 开辟 </u> 了一条清晰的阅读路径，用 <u> 礼貌 </u> 且 <u> 坦诚的 </u> 口吻提供了全面的 <u> 概述 </u> ，极具可读性与信息量。

paragraphs.en: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design , AI is already super-smart and will become more {capable} , moving from the {current} generation of “narrow AI” to Artificial {General} Intelligence.From there, Campbell comes up with a timely {forecast} of Artificial Dominant Intelligence.This is why Campbell has set out to raise awareness of AI and its future now—several decades before these developments are expected to take place.She says it is {essential} that we keep control of artificial intelligence, or risk being {sidelined} , because the {Go} -playing AlphaGo already has an advantage over human players.
paragraphs.cn: 我们很快就会从《设计人工智能》中了解到，人工智能已具备超级智能，并且 <u> 能力 </u> 会不断增强，从 <u> 当前的 </u> “狭义人工智能”发展到“ <u> 通用 </u> 人工智能”。在此基础上，坎贝尔及时地对“人工主导智能”做出了 <u> 预测 </u> 。这就是为什么坎贝尔现在就开始提高人们对人工智能及其未来的认识——尽管这些预计要几十年后才会发生。她说，我们 <u> 必须 </u> 掌控人工智能，否则就面临被 <u> 边缘化 </u> 的风险，毕竟会下 <u> 围棋 </u> 的阿尔法Go已经比人类棋手更具优势。

paragraphs.en: Campbell's point is to wake up those responsible for AI—the technology companies and world leaders—so they are on the same page as all the experts {currently} {proceeding} with it.She explains we are at a“ {tipping} point” in history and must act now to prevent the {extinction} of humanity.We need to consider how we want our future with Al to {pan} out.Such structured thinking, followed by {legal} {regulation} and proper {instruction} , will help {defend} human rights in an AI-driven world.
paragraphs.cn: 坎贝尔意在唤醒那些负责人工智能的人——科技公司和世界各国领导人，让他们与 <u> 目前进行 </u> 人工智能研究的所有专家达成共识。她解释说，我们正处于历史的“ <u> 转折 </u> 点”，必须立即行动起来，防止人类 <u> 灭绝 </u> 。我们需要思考我们希望与人工智能共生的未来如何 <u> 发展 </u> 。这种有条理的思考，再加上 <u> 法律监管 </u> 和适当的 <u> 指导 </u> ，将有助于在人工智能驱动的世界中 <u> 捍卫 </u> 人权。

paragraphs.en: AI will affect us all, and if you only read one book on the subject, this is it.
